sam (marketing): Quick sync  we want to announce 'Adaptive Routing' next week. Need: final changelog link, docs URL, a single-sentence benchmark for the blog, and rollout timing.

drew (eng): changelog PR is open: https://git.internal/redwood/changelog/pulls/1177. Small opt-in API field `routing_policy`. Non-breaking by default.

anya (docs): Ill prep the docs page. Can you paste a minimal request example and a migration note?

drew (eng): example for docs: POST /v1/infer { "model": "rwd-adaptive-v1", "routing_policy": { "type": "latency" } } Migration: pinned `rwd-standard` keeps previous routing; set `routing_policy` to opt in.

lucy (ops): Deploy plan proposal: 2% canary in us-west for 4h, then 25% ramp if healthy. We can publish docs at canary start.

mike (product): Webinar: Apr 9, 10am PT. Slides: bench, migration steps, canary plan. Marketing needs a one-liner bench for the banner.

drew (eng): internal perf summary: p95 125ms -> 104ms (~17%), est token cost -12%.

sam (marketing): Perfect. I'll draft the banner and landing page and set publish at canary start. Please react with :eyes: when changelog/docs are merged so copy can be locked.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled job #deploy-174999 for 2026-04-08T22:00:00Z. Canary: us-west-2 2% 4h.
